disagreements.positions: Agents 2 and 4: 24.3x (10 peers incl. MKSI, UCTT, PLAB, KALU). Agent 1: 28.5x (incl. AME, JX, Umicore). Agent 5: 29.0x (incl. AMKR, ROG). Agent 3: 32.9x (incl. COHR, ROG).
disagreements.resolution: The difference comes from peer-set composition, not from the data: every forward P/E checked matches stockanalysis exactly. Semicap equipment and OSAT names (MKSI, UCTT, PLAB, AMKR) and lasers (COHR) are not materials businesses, so I drop them. My set is CRS, ATI, HWM, HXL (A&D alloys/materials), ENTG, ESI, ROG, JX Advanced Metals (5016.T), Umicore (UMI.BR) (electronic and precious-metal materials) and KALU. Its plain median is 31.0x. Weighting the cluster medians by MTRN's H1 2026 value-added mix gives ~28.5x: Performance Materials 58% at the alloy cluster's 33.0x, Electronic Materials 31% at the electronic-materials cluster's 19.6x, Precision Optics 11% at ~30x. Reconciled peer median: ~29x.
disagreements.evidence: stockanalysis statistics pages, 2026-10-02 close (15 peers re-fetched); Q2 2026 8-K segment value-added sales (PM ~$329.5M, EM $179.0M, PO $61.5M in H1).

disagreements.topic: Premium or discount to the peer median
disagreements.positions: Agent 1 and agent 5: at the median. Agent 2: at the median (+3%). Agent 4: +7% (beryllium moat, own 5-year median). Agent 3: -15% (growth, margin on net sales, FCF).
disagreements.resolution: No premium is justified. MTRN's ROIC is 8.27% against a peer median of ~11.7% (CRS 22.3%, ATI 18.4%, HWM 23.0%, HXL 10.1%, ENTG 7.0%, ESI 5.5%, ROG 3.9%, KALU 13.2%). Its next-year EPS growth is +20.1% against a peer median of ~+24%. FCF conversion is the weakest in the group, and adjusted EBITDA was flat from 2024 to 2025 ($221.2M -> $217.0M). The beryllium moat is real but sits inside a minority of earnings. A modest persistent discount (~27x, -7%) is defensible on ROIC and growth. Margin on net sales is not a valid ground, because pass-through metal distorts it. MTRN trades at 39.4x, a ~36% premium, which I treat as momentum and theme flow, not fair value.
disagreements.evidence: stockanalysis ROIC and forecast pages; Q4 2025 8-K (FY2025 adj EBITDA $217.0M vs $221.2M).

Applying the peer multiple to adjusted EBITDA overstates the EV leg by ~15%: about -$16/share on agent 1's fair value, -$18 on agent 4's and -$13 on agent 5's. Equivalent multiple on adjusted EBITDA: ~16x.

comps_review.peer_set_judgment: All five sets rely on one aggregator, so they are one source. The A&D alloy names (CRS, ATI, HXL, HWM) and the electronic/precious-metal materials names (ENTG, ESI, JX Advanced Metals, Umicore, ROG) are sensible. JX is MTRN's most direct sputter-target competitor and Umicore shares the precious-metal pass-through model; only agents 1 and 2 include JX and only agent 1 includes Umicore. Semicap equipment, OSAT and photonics names (MKSI, UCTT, PLAB, AMKR, COHR) and instruments (AME) are not genuine comparables, and UCTT and KALU carry distorted earnings bases.

summary: Round 2 corrected every fact I flagged, and every new fact checks out: the SEMI WFE path, missile procurement +188%, JX's +60% capacity, the director Form 4s and short interest +20% m/m. All peer forward P/Es match the source. Fair values converged from $253-325 to $247-276. That is partly anchoring on my round-1 file (the 1-month ladders and thesis breaks copy my parameters) and partly one shared data source (every agent's comps come from stockanalysis); the 12-month values are not anchored on my $280, since four of five ended below it. My one material correction: three agents apply peer EV/EBITDA to adjusted EBITDA, which runs ~15% above the standardized basis. On a ~29x materials-peer median, MTRN's 39x carries an unjustified ~36% premium given its below-peer ROIC and growth, and my fair value is ~$258 against the $312 spot. I keep the ladder close to the agent mean (P(>= $312) ~42%) with low confidence.

With ~55-60% volatility, beating SPY's Sharpe needs roughly +25-30%, and my ladder gives P(>= $375) ~28% and P(>= $421) ~20%. It would be a third AI-capex bet in a small book and carries defense-rule ambiguity, so cap it as a small satellite.
sizing.conviction_label_reason: The checked evidence shows good fundamentals already more than priced: 39x against a ~29x peer median with below-peer ROIC and growth, and fair value ~$258 below the $312 spot. So there is no expected-return edge over the S&P 500 for the next 12 months.
